acceptance.calibration: descriptive only at n<=14; full Choice distributions retained per row; no threshold change post hoc
acceptance.confirmedPagePrecision: reported as attempts/fetches/detail-pages/confirmations; value null until a product-detail page with identity/variant match is demonstrated
acceptance.correctAbstentions: all gold-abstain rows abstain (currently includes dev-05 off-domain and dev-14; dev-06/dev-08/dev-11 class noted below)
acceptance.knownDeviations: dev-11 selects at high confidence against an abstain gold (variant-verification gap, recorded as failed frozen decision — must not be relabeled without variant evidence)
acceptance.retrieval: every row retains retrieval time, source revision, approved-domain authority, candidate URLs+ranks+provenance, and failures/missing products — fixed population including negatives
acceptance.selectorCorrectGivenCoverage: >= 0.80 on frozen dev set (fixed population, abstentions scored separately)

activation: OFF — activation is explicitly NOT granted by this policy. v2 binds live retrieval + verifier evidence. Requires: (1) independent freeze attestation (different reviewer instance) with corpus + source-revision pins, (2) authorized holdout evaluation with logged unseal, (3) reviewed live canary with operator attestation, (4) routing/data-sharing approval of the evaluated pins, (5) disable-to-manual verification. No paid calls beyond the bounded evaluation budget; no store writes.
fittedOn: sitemap-selection-dev-v2 (live retrieval; holdout sealed at fit time)

freezeReview.reviewer: UNASSIGNED - independent reviewer sign-off required (different reviewer instance from the implementing agent)
freezeReview.scope: Attest corpus bytes + source revision + pins match; v1 preserved byte-identical.
freezeReview.statement: No independent review yet. Activation stays OFF until status=signed.

holdoutStatus: NOT CREATED — requires independent custody/versioning procedure; v1 holdout untouched and unexecuted

holdoutUnseal.accessControl: HOLDOUT_UNSEAL=<review-id> env token (auditable approval id, never a source edit), same as v1
holdoutUnseal.requirement: activation-time requirement: reviewer id, date, purpose, and verified holdoutSha256 logged in the v2 qualification report before any v2 holdout row is executed. No post-holdout fitting.

rule: accept-when-all-retrieval-candidates-share-one-approved-domain-and-variant-tokens-match-else-abstain; single-candidate-or-exact-identity → deterministic verify path (no model call); empty retrieval → coverage_gap; off-domain-only candidates → insufficient_evidence (never select); mixed-domain sets with no in-domain match → no_match; low-probability (P<0.50) → low_model_probability abstention; never clip, never fall back to chat, never select an unseen URL. v2 addition: actual live retrieval precedes selection (retained with time/source/provenance); verifier fetch + identity/variant evidence required per selected URL; deterministic-bypass handoffs verified the same way; confirmed-page precision counts only product-detail pages with identity/variant match, never bare fetches.
sourceRevisionNote: Per-row sitemapSourceUrl + fetchedAt retained; no content hash of the live sitemap is pinned yet. A freeze must either pin sitemap content hashes or declare crawl-time capture as the evaluated source with its fetchedAt.
